title: Release snapshot comparator and cohort-bias detector for embedding + reranker changes
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Configuration flips (quantization profiles, KV cache toggles, model variant swaps) and model updates can subtly change embedding geometry and reranker scores without obvious token-level errors. We need a reproducible snapshot comparator that ties a candidate release to a baseline via offline recall/precision metrics, distributional drift measures, and cohort-level bias detectors so releases can be gated automatically or sent back for investigation.

This ticket builds the comparator service and wiring for automated gating in the release pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: A snapshot comparator tool that takes (baseline snapshot, candidate snapshot) and emits a standardized report JSON with: recall@k, precision@k, nDCG@k across configured cohorts
Comparator computes distributional drift metrics for embeddings: cosine mean shifts, KL divergence over binned norms, and per-feature median shift for top-100 dimensions
Bias detector alerts on cohort-level delta > threshold for recall/precision or > X% rank-preservation loss for protected cohorts
Comparator integrates with existing eval harness and can be triggered as part of PR checks and the nightly release pipeline
Report contains reproducible links: sample queries failing worst delta, seeds to reproduce reranker differences, and a lightweight diff visualization (histogram + qq-plot)
New comparator adds a boolean 'block_release' flag when regressions exceed thresholds; default policy is conservative and surfaced to PM/RE to override
tasks: Design stable snapshot schema (embeddings, reranker logits, metadata, cohort tags, quantization flags)
Implement comparator core: recall/precision/nDCG calculators with cohort partitioning
Add embedding distribution metrics: cosine shift, norm histograms, KL on binned distributions
Implement rank-preservation metric and top-k churn for reranker outputs
Wire bias detector rules and default thresholds; add config for dynamic thresholds per customer cohort
Expose comparator as a CLI + lightweight HTTP endpoint for CI; produce report artifacts to S3 and link to Console
Add unit & integration tests: synthetic shift scenarios, quantization sensitivity cases, and non-regression on known-good snapshots
Document runbook for investigating comparator failures and auto-generated triage checklist
notes: Initial threshold proposals: recall@10 drop > 3% or nDCG@10 drop > 2% => warn; recall@10 drop > 7% or rank-preservation < 85% => block. Cohort-level thresholds scale stricter for legal/PII cohorts. We'll iterate after 2 weeks of A/B shadow runs. Use existing eval harness as data source (see ENG-12840).
